params.body:
The desktop bar held seven links plus language, Support and Get started, and still had no room for News: that link only showed in the folded menu, so on a wide screen the footer was the only way to the news. Nothing on the homepage or the CyberSec page pointed to the first news post either.

## Menu (`Nav.astro`, `global.css`, `Footer.astro`)

| Main group | Then | Under "About" |
|---|---|---|
| IT Lab, Offline Server, School platform, Communities | News | Our approach, Where it runs, Team |

- **Five links and one dropdown** instead of seven links, with News now visible on a wide screen.
- **Communities moves into the main group**, beside the three products. It is marked as the current page on `/communities/cybersec` too.
- **"About" is a dropdown** (`<details>`), in the same family as the language menu: opens on click, closes on a click elsewhere or on Escape, marks the current page. The existing outside-click handler now covers both.
- **"Deployments" is labelled "Where it runs"** in the menu and the footer (fr "Là où ça tourne", nl "Waar het draait"), after the page's own heading. The page and its address are unchanged.
- **The folded menu is unchanged in kind**: every link listed flat under its group heading. Communities is now under "The system", and News leads the "About" group.

## Homepage (`index.astro`, `global.css`)

- **"Latest news"**, after "Running in schools since 2017": the newest post's photo, date, title and summary, with links to the story and to all news. It reuses the `feature-bleed` block of the section above it. Read from Sanity at build time; with no post, or Sanity unreachable, the block is left out.
- English homepage only: the posts are not translated.

## CyberSec page (`CyberSecPage.astro`)

- A link to the story of the first event, under the event figures. The Dutch and French pages get it too, marked as English.

## Checked

- `npm test`: 25 passed. `npm run build` and `npm run check:built`: no contact number.
- Menu in en, fr and nl at 1421, 1440 and 1701 wide: nothing cut off, dropdown opens and closes, no page errors. Folded menu at 390 wide lists all eight links.
- Homepage block and CyberSec link at 1440 and 390 wide: no horizontal scroll.
params.title: Menu: an About dropdown and News in the bar; latest story on the homepage and CyberSec page
